facts.fact: N+One Datacenters, a Casablanca-based data centre operator founded in 2008, operates two data centres in Morocco (unnamed here); a third, 2,000 sqm, at Nouaceur is only planned for later in 2024 (DCD, 3 January 2024; as_of is the article date, none given).

note: Operating status of two N+One centres recorded; the Nouaceur one is planned, so not a fact.
